name: Sample house
description: Sophie's one-story sample: about 3,600 sq ft, 76 ft east-west by 47 ft north-south (a golden-ratio footprint). Rammed earth on the south, hempcrete on the north, east, and west. Living, kitchen, and office face south. Bedrooms sit on the east. Baths, laundry, and the garage sit on the north. A shaded patio is on the west. Phase 1 is a four-room core inside that footprint. Later rooms are future wings.
disclaimer: Editable SAMPLE layout, not a final design. Not an engineered drawing and not for permitting.

notes: SAMPLE layout for James and Sophie. Not a final design, not an engineered drawing, and not for permitting.
Units are feet. +x is east, +y is north. The origin is the southwest corner of the full footprint.
Wall start and end are centerlines. Thickness is centered on that segment. Corners are butt joints.
South exterior walls are rammed earth, 18 inches. Other exterior walls are hempcrete, 12 inches. Interior partitions are framed, 6 inches.
Phase 1 is a weathertight four-room core. Its hempcrete north, east, and west walls remain in the full house, with doors into the later wings.
The roof is placeholder massing for a Chinese hip-and-gable. It is not a structural design.
This file has no prices. Do not add one unless it cites a source URL and the date it was checked.
Wall thickness and framing come from data/assemblies.json. Header sizes come from data/headers.json. Both are placeholders and are not code citations.
The 76 by 47 ft footprint is stored as a golden constraint (width = φ × depth). 76/47 is about 0.06% short of exact φ, and the plan says so instead of changing the drawn walls.

electrical.note: Starter layout for the phase 1 core. Suggested receptacles were accepted, then a panel, range, dryer, lights, a bath fan, a switch, and two smoke alarms were added. Later wings are left empty.

plumbing.note: Phase 1 starter. Bathroom fixtures share the bath's east partition. The kitchen sink is on the nearest interior wall, because the kitchen and bath do not share a wall. The building drain ties those wet walls to a septic stub at the south edge.
